findings.rationale: The Allow statement grants Action "*", so its holder can perform every supported action rather than only the intended operations.
The Allow statement applies to Resource "*", so even a narrowed action would not be contained to designated AWS resources.
The account-wide wildcard identity grant, when combined with the public-read ACL on tf_s3_public_access, enables policy holders to read every object in that exposed bucket.
